visual.description: Deep forest green used as the primary hero section background and navigation bar background.
Warm off-white/cream used as the main page background across content sections.
Pure white used for card surfaces and inner content panels.
Soft pink used as a highlight/accent background behind key headline words and CTA cards.
Very dark plum/burgundy used for large display headings on light backgrounds.
Same deep forest green also used for body text, subheadings, and labels on light backgrounds.
Muted grey-purple used for de-emphasized section headings and inactive step numbers.
White used for headings and navigation links on the dark green hero/nav background.
Cream/off-white used for the outline secondary button ('Je suis vendeur') on the hero.
Pink used as the filled primary CTA button background ('Je suis acheteur', 'S'inscrire').
Purple used for 'Article' category badge/tag pills on blog listing cards.
Pink used for secondary category badge pills (B2B, Exercice pro) on blog cards.
Slightly deeper pink used for the outlined reference number badge borders on listing cards.
Light mint/sage green circle used for step number indicators in the process section.
Forest green also used as a filled card/panel background for 'Explorer par atouts' and community sections.
